bvh.scope: shared primitives, distinct traversal; analytic geometry tests run separately

image.scope: PNG signature, chunks/CRCs, RGB format, dimensions, decompression and scanlines

source_digest_recipe: sha256(sorted relative path + NUL + bytes + NUL), src/tests Python, checks.py and pyproject.toml

quick_start.method: extracted the single README shell block and executed it with bash -e from repository root

default_render.timing: CLI perf_counter; scene build, rendering, PNG encoding; one observed run, not a benchmark average
default_render.visual_inspection: PASS; inspected actual image, distinct materials, refraction, reflection, triangle sculpture and shadows

wheel_check.scope: built wheel installed in a separate target directory; imported from that directory and rendered from /tmp using the existing Pillow environment

assurance_limits: Public same-author tests, not held-out evidence or a proof.
Local execution used Python 3.13.5; Python 3.11 syntax parsed. CI is a separate execution record.
Local Git transport used hash-verified sparse base objects because direct Git/DNS was unavailable.
material_failed_probes: Initial isolated pip build could not download setuptools because network/DNS was unavailable. Quick Start explicitly provisions the build dependency and disables only build isolation.
Two provisional 360x225, 9-sample renders exceeded 120-second tool limits; default reduced explicitly to 4 samples and rerun successfully.
A no-deps wheel render in a venv without Pillow failed as expected for the missing runtime dependency; the wheel was then verified in a separate target with Pillow available.
